root.label: William Arnold makes 52 calls at Isle of Lewis pay phone

events.label: William Arnold makes 52 calls at Isle of Lewis pay phone

slots.name: distance driven
slots.sentence: William Arnold drove 900 miles from his home in Cornwall this summer to a windswept pay phone on the Isle of Lewis.

slots.name: calls made
slots.sentence: When he got there, he pulled out a big bag of coins and started making calls, 52 of them to be precise.

slots.name: minimum usage threshold
slots.sentence: In doing so, he ensured the phone booth met the minimum threshold of a call a week to stay in service another year.
